Definition: perhaps akin to G3586; a forest, i.e. (by implication) fuel:--matter.
BiblicalUsage: The word hýlē carries the sense of a forest, wood, fuel. In James 3:5, the text says "how great a matter a little fire kindleth!"
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hýlē, does its job quietly — a forest, wood, fuel — and I leave it at that.
